0.26.2: Usage: fixed reading of Claude usage limits

0.26.0: Usage: plan usage rings in the bottom bar and in mobile chat
Remote VMs: several people can share one VM, each with their own DevChain
Teams: leads can restart, compact or stop a team member
Providers: OpenCode 2 support, and Codex plugins on the Plugins page
Dev Template: shorter plan reviews, and the lead replies to every review

Host image 1.5.0: support for VMs that several users share, and OpenCode 2
0.25.0: Mobile app 1.11.0: out of beta and live on the App Store and Google Play
Security: stronger protection for phone pairing, cloud sign-in and browser requests
Remote VMs: Docker moves work on more VMs, files of any owner sync, and custom VM sizes use sliders
Terminal: messages no longer reach the shell after an agent's CLI exits
Projects: a reminder when a project uses an older template, and custom prompts can be previewed and deleted from chat
Stability: a recovery screen instead of a blank page when something fails
Breaking changes: if you open DevChain through a custom hostname, add it to ALLOWED_HOSTS unless it is already the configured HOST.

Breaking changes: the mobile app connection now requires end-to-end encryption by default. Update clients that send unencrypted requests. E2EE_REQUIRED=false restores the previous setting but permits unencrypted traffic.
0.24.2: Remote VMs: smoother and more reliable Connect, Disconnect and file sync, with better Docker support and a new Projects tab
Host image 1.4.0: more tools for agents, and the VM user gets the same user ids as this PC, which moving Docker containers needs
Dev Template: clearer rules for writing tests, and agents run only the affected tests before review
Stability: skill sync no longer fills the temp folder, and queued test runs no longer overload the machine
0.24.1: Mobile app 1.10.2: a more live and responsive chat experience
Remote VMs: more control over Connect. You can cancel it, choose which Docker containers to move, and see progress while it runs
Remote VMs: more reliable Connect and sign-in
Stability: smoother pasting into Claude, and restored agents keep their DevChain tools
Teams and templates: teams keep their order after a template update, and the Dev Template has updated defaults
0.24.0: Remote VMs: run a project's agents on your own Proxmox or Ubuntu/Debian VM, from the same app, over an encrypted connection.
Stability: smoother terminals and transcripts, and full Codex history
Look: Dark is the default theme, and Ocean has higher contrast
Dev Template: renamed to DevChain Development Flow
Mobile app 1.10.0: one project list across home and your VMs, and the last chat reopens at launch

[Fix] Automation: "Coder reset" can wait while epics are in chosen statuses, so it keeps coders other phases still need
[Impr] Dev Template: GPT-6 family models, a skill review prompt, and better bundled skills
[New] Skills: "Project skill review" suggests which skills to enable or disable, based on usage
